name: PMO Project Status
query:
SELECT
    name AS "Project:Link/PMO Project:220",
    project_title AS "Project:Data:220",
    project_code AS "Project Code:Data:140",
    program AS "Programme:Link/PMO Program:200",
    portfolio AS "Portfolio:Link/PMO Portfolio:200",
    project_manager AS "Project Manager:Link/User:180",
    start_date AS "Start Date:Date:110",
    end_date AS "End Date:Date:110",
    status AS "Status:Data:140"
FROM `tabPMO Project`
ORDER BY
    CASE status
        WHEN 'In Progress' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Open' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Pending Approval' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Approved' THEN 4
        WHEN 'Draft' THEN 5
        WHEN 'Completed' THEN 6
        WHEN 'Closed' THEN 7
        ELSE 8
    END,
    end_date
